correctness.rationale: The exact rational vertex proof checks all C(14,5)=2002 basic systems from a 5-dimensional compact polytope, yields eight verified vertices, and applies a necessary-and-sufficient convex-averaging criterion to every one of the 255 frequency masks. Twenty accepted masks each have an explicit rational witness; arbitrary dimensions follow from surjective restriction and its fiber size 2^(d-3). All six sites require strict positivity and both missing sites vanish.

value.rationale: This is the full positional feasibility classification for a natural six-point orbit of nonnegative positive-definite Walsh signals. Identifying exactly 20 of 255 masks and the eight extreme rays provides a reusable exact feasibility test, stronger than conventional uncertainty cardinality estimates, with an all-dimensional subgroup extension. The particular invariant is motivated by simultaneous positivity in signal/filter design and by distinguishing feasible spectral deletions; the finite basis case is intrinsically complete rather than a chosen example.
